observation_summary: The .asPath() method produces incorrect XPath expressions or enters an infinite loop when encountering nodes with an empty namespace declaration.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the DOMNodePointer class was returning an empty string (" ") for nodes that do not have a namespace, whereas the JXPath framework expects a null value to represent the absence of a namespace. This discrepancy caused the NamespaceResolver to fail or loop when attempting to resolve prefixes for nodes that were explicitly defined with an empty namespace (xmlns=""). The fix ensures that any empty string returned as a namespace URI is normalized to null, aligning the DOM model's behavior with the rest of the JXPath framework.
